name: crapkit
description: Deterministic CRAP-score tooling for 14 languages: complexity x coverage per function, a ranked worklist, and a commit gate that only ever tightens.

plugins.name: crapkit
plugins.description: crapkit's agent surface: three skills, the read-side MCP server, and one advisory PostToolUse hook that names functions an edit pushed over their ceiling. Needs the `crapkit` console script on PATH (pip install crapkit, 0.4.0 or newer); `crapkit doctor --plugin-root` says whether an installed copy and the CLI agree.
